latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Closing-Attitude Self-Assessment skill based on the SPIN Selling 15-item validated psychometric scale.
- Interactively administers all 15 official scale items and calculates a total closing-attitude score (15–75).
- Collects specific selling context (deal value, buyer sophistication, post-sale relationship) to interpret results accurately.
- Delivers a written assessment and tailored remediation guidance when the user's closing attitude is mismatched to their sales context.
- Supports discovery by answering queries like “evaluate my closing attitude,” “should I close harder,” and “am I closing too aggressively.”
